name: 集装箱装箱数量估算（汽车）

map.集装箱装箱数量估算器，输入货物尺寸与数量估算所需集装箱数，辅助物流配载与运输规划: Container loading estimator: enter cargo dimensions and quantity to estimate how many containers are needed, supporting logistics loading and transport planning.
map.40 尺高柜（限高 2.5 m，约 59 m³）: 40ft high cube (2.5 m height limit, about 59 m³)
map.体积与重量双约束: Both volume and weight limits applied
map.轻货、需堆高: Light cargo that must be stacked high
map.超轻货（部分航线受限）: Very light cargo (restricted on some routes)
map.货物形状不规则、需要留通道、不能倒置或限高时，实际可装体积常只有标称的 80%~: With irregular shapes, needed access aisles, no-flip rules or height limits, usable volume is often only 80%~90% of nominal. Reserve a 10%~20% broken-stowage factor in estimates, otherwise you get "fits on paper, not in the box".
map.轻泡货由体积决定箱数，重货由限重决定。取两者所需箱数的较大值才是可行方案；同时注: Light bulky cargo is sized by volume and heavy cargo by payload limit; take the larger of the two container counts as the workable plan. Also confirm that gross container weight stays within the carrier's and destination country's road limits.
map.💡 拼箱（LCL）适合不足一整柜的小批量；当估算箱数接近整数上限（如 4.8 柜: 💡 LCL suits batches too small for a full container; when the estimate nears a whole number (say 4.8 boxes), compare "5 full containers" against "4 containers + LCL" before deciding.
map.物流配载时，输入单件货长宽高与数量，估算所需标准集装箱（20/40 尺）个数，避: In logistics loading plans, enter unit length, width, height and quantity to estimate how many standard containers (20/40 ft) are needed, avoiding broken stowage or overloading.
map.多规格货物混装时，按体积与重量双约束排布，校核是否超重或空间浪费。: For mixed-size cargo, arrange under both volume and weight constraints and check for overload or wasted space.
map.出口发运前，用估算结果对比拼箱与整箱成本，选择更优方案。: Before export shipping, use the estimate to compare LCL against FCL cost and choose the better option.
map.单件货物 1.0×0.8×0.6m=0.48m³、共 500 件=240m³；4: One piece 1.0×0.8×0.6m=0.48m³, 500 pieces = 240 m³; a 40ft container holds about 67 m³ internally, so 240/67 ≈ 3.6, i.e. 4 containers. Checking weight: at 80 kg each the total is 40 t, so 4 containers at 10 t each stay far below the 22–28 t payload limit; volume governs, so 4 × 40ft containers.
map.体积算够为什么还装不下？: Why does it not fit even though the volume adds up?
map.集装箱内尺寸固定，货物若不能紧密堆码（形状不规则、需留通道、限高），实际能装体积: Container internal dimensions are fixed, and if cargo cannot stack tightly (irregular shapes, required aisles, height limits) usable volume is often only 80%–90% of nominal. Reserve a 10%–20% broken-stowage factor and verify each container meets the weight limit.
map.20 尺和 40 尺怎么选？: How do I choose between 20ft and 40ft?
map.20 尺柜内积约 33m³、限重约 22–28t，适合重货或小批量；40 尺柜约: A 20ft container holds about 33 m³ with a 22–28 t limit, suiting heavy cargo or small batches; a 40ft holds about 67 m³ with a similar limit, suiting light bulky cargo. Choose 40ft for light goods to save freight, and 20ft when weight limits make it the more flexible option.
map.估算未含货物不可堆叠、限高与绑扎空间等约束，实际装载建议预留 10%~20% 亏: Estimates exclude non-stackable cargo, height limits and lashing space; reserve 10%~20% broken stowage in practice
